run_clm_training: run default causal language model training with a config dict or LLMTrainingParams object
run_process_data: process a dataset by filling nulls, selecting the text column, and optionally appending the EOS token
review_train_function: review the train function that orchestrates data loading, tokenization, grouping, and HuggingFace Trainer execution
